skills.name: Lunatic - Copy
lines: Activate Lunatic status Copy on user (3 turns)
* Copy: Skills execute twice.
** Copy has 0 MP cost and no AF gain.
** Copy increases Combo multiplier in AF normally.
** Copy counts as another move for move-based buffs.
** Copy animation happens after the original skill use and plays out fully.
** Copy will move on to the next enemy if the original target dies from the first attack.
* Replaces the basic attack until used (1 activation)

skills.name: Astral Shine
lines: Crystal type magic attack on all enemies (S) and Guaranteed Critical
* Damage of skill increases with fewer enemies on the battlefield
** Base multiplier is 450% when only 1 enemy
** Subtract 90% for each additional enemy (Minimum of 90%, when 5+ enemies)
* If the currently selected enemy's HP is above 50% after attack, Attack again at no extra MP cost (Multiplier x2)
** During Copy Lunatic, this is checked after the initial skill use is copied
*** If this second execution successfully triggers, Copy Lunatic will also copy it, regardless of remaining HP of enemies
** Counts as a separate move, so will increase Another Force gauge again
